original_content_full:
The paper "Consistent Filtering of Videos and Dense Light-Fields Without Optic-Flow" by Sumit Shekhar, Amir Semmo, Matthias Trapp, Okan Tarhan Tursun, Sebastian Pasewaldt, Karol Myszkowski, and Jürgen Döllner has been accepted as a contribution to the 24th International Symposium on Vision, Modeling, and Visualization (VMV 2019). The conference will be held at the University of Rostock from Sep 30 - Oct 2, 2019. 

Links:  https://www.vmv2019.uni-rostock.de/
